notes: P02 independent per-case truth oracle for RQ1-RQ3 (PolicyTrace: Temporal Conformance Testing of Delegated Consent across Heterogeneous Policy Engines). independent_oracle.py: adjudicate(case) -> OracleResult DELEGATES entirely to the audited shared kernel evaluation/venue2027/_shared/oracle_kernel.adjudicate with the module-local declarative SACMAT rule table SACMAT_RULES = {conformant->ADMIT, expiry_divergence->REJECT, policy_skew->REJECT, obligation_mismatch->REJECT} (registered dataset-kernel ground-truth families); undeclared/unknown families return first-class INDETERMINATE (kernel reason codes NO_FAMILY_DECLARED / UNMODELLED_FAMILY, never a silent safe verdict) and a missing case_id raises the stable kernel reason code MISSING_CASE_ID. ORACLE_ID='sacmat-conformance-reference'; evidence URIs from the case record flow into OracleResult.evidence_refs; SACMAT_ORACLE_VERSION='1.0.0'; JSON-serializable output (kernel_version pinned). INDEPENDENCE (GATES/INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL.md item 2): the module does NOT import the SACMAT candidate machinery — evaluation/venue2027/sacmat/baselines.py (B0-B3 arms with the in-process engine models) nor evaluation/venue2027/sacmat/policy_trace_dsl.py (temporal DSL); verify_independence(source=None) runs two layered ast scans on the oracle source (live module by default, injected text in tests): (1) the audited kernel contract oracle_kernel.assert_oracle_independence with FORBIDDEN_MODULE_NAMES = ('sacmat.baselines','baselines','policy_trace_dsl') — root-component matching plus DYNAMIC_IMPORT_UNRESOLVABLE on __import__/import_module — and (2) a module-local full-target scan matching every dotted import path component and from-module-import alias binds against the same forbidden names, closing the package-qualified form the kernel-level root match legitimately cannot name without forbidding the repo's own package root; matching is exact per dotted component (never substring), so unrelated modules like sacmat_baseline_helpers do not trip it; violations raise OracleError CANDIDATE_IMPORT naming every offending target. TRUTH PROVENANCE: ground truth derives from the case's declared policy/consent family — tests prove candidate-claimed reason codes (CANDIDATE_CLAIMED_*/B3_*/PERMIT/DENY) and forged observed_outcome/arm blocks never flip a verdict off the ground truth. test_independent_oracle.py imports only the oracle and the shared kernel (independent-oracle rule): 32 passed — 10 positive controls (four registered families match the manual canonical history, kernel-delegation identity, nested payload family, rule-table shape/oracle_id/version, determinism + JSON round-trip with pinned kernel_version, evidence capture) and 22 adversarial (5 parametrized candidate-reason-code non-influence vectors, forged arm observation ignored, unknown family INDETERMINATE, missing family INDETERMINATE, missing case_id, clean live source passes, 10 candidate-import variants refused, dynamic import refused, tampered-live-source flip control, exact-acceptance of unrelated imports). uvx ruff@0.7.1 check + format --check clean (ruff.toml). source_sha_after records the base commit e5f7ee3b per sibling convention (SACMAT-X01/SACMAT-baselines); the single task commit SHA is created immediately after this report and reported in the handoff. oracle_disagreement_count=0 (32/32 oracle verdicts consistent with the kernel contract); baseline parity NOT_APPLICABLE (oracle layer; arms B0-B3 execute via SACMAT-baselines).
